scope: Germany-wide post-birth companion with Berlin-specific registration guidance. Official-source routing only; no authority submission performed by this app.

services.title: Geburt beurkunden / Standesamt
facts: The federal family portal says the child should be registered with the registry office within 7 working days.
In Berlin, hospitals and birth centres transmit the birth notification to the competent registry office; for a home birth, parents must present the birth certificate within one week.
Berlin issues three free purpose-specific certificates for Elterngeld, Kindergeld and health insurance.

services.title: Krankenkasse informieren
facts: The federal post-birth checklist says parents should inform their health insurer about the birth.

services.title: Kindergeld
facts: Kindergeld applications are free and are decided by the Familienkasse.
The 2026 amount is 259 EUR per month per eligible child.
A BundID allows the online application to be transmitted without printing and signing.

services.title: Elterngeld
facts: Elterngeld can only be applied for after birth.
The federal family portal recommends applying directly after birth and within the first three life months because Elterngeld is paid at most three life months retroactively.
As of August 2026 the former ElterngeldDigital service routes new applications to mein-elterngeldantrag.de; all federal states offer a digital application route.

services.title: Mutterschaftsleistungen
facts: Employed members of a statutory health insurer may receive maternity benefit from their insurer.
After birth, the birth certificate is needed for continued payment.
People who are privately insured or family-insured may under conditions qualify for maternity benefit from the Federal Office for Social Security.

services.title: Vaterschaft anerkennen
facts: If the parents are married at birth, a separate paternity acknowledgement is generally not necessary.
If the parents are not married, paternity acknowledgement is needed for the father to be legally recognized and requires the mother's consent.
It can be done before birth at, for example, a Jugendamt, Standesamt, court or notary.

services.title: Gemeinsame Sorge erklären
facts: For unmarried parents, paternity acknowledgement does not automatically create joint custody.
Joint custody can be established by custody declarations, for example at the Jugendamt or a notary, or by a court decision.

services.title: Elternzeit beim Arbeitgeber anmelden
facts: Elternzeit is notified to the employer rather than applied for with an authority.
It generally must be declared in text form at least seven weeks before the intended start.

For the mother, post-birth maternity protection normally lasts eight weeks, so notification after birth can still be timely for leave starting afterwards; the other parent wanting leave from birth generally needs to notify seven weeks before the expected birth date.
